intro.en: Text apps use TextAnalyticsClient, speech apps use the Speech SDK, and spoken prompts go to an audio-capable model.
intro.ro: Text apps TextAnalyticsClient, speech apps Speech SDK istemal karti hain, aur bole gaye prompts audio wale model ko jate hain.

text.en: Takes a list of documents and returns one result per document; check is_error first.
text.ro: Documents ki list leta hai aur har document ka nateeja deta hai; pehle is_error dekhein.

text.en: begin_abstract_summary and others return a poller; call result() to wait.
text.ro: begin_abstract_summary waghera poller dete hain; intezar ke liye result() call karein.

text.en: Key and region (or endpoint and token) plus language and voice settings.
text.ro: Key aur region (ya endpoint aur token), zabaan aur awaaz ki settings.

text.en: Where audio comes from or goes to: microphone, speaker or file.
text.ro: Audio kahan se aati ya jati hai: microphone, speaker ya file.

text.en: recognize_once_async for one sentence; continuous recognition with events for long audio.
text.ro: Ek jumlay ke liye recognize_once_async; lambi audio ke liye events wali continuous recognition.

text.en: speak_text_async for plain text, speak_ssml_async for SSML.
text.ro: Saade text ke liye speak_text_async, SSML ke liye speak_ssml_async.

text.en: Chat with input_audio parts; modalities ["text", "audio"] return speech; Realtime API for live talk.
text.ro: input_audio parts wala chat; modalities ["text", "audio"] awaaz deti hain; live guftagu ke liye Realtime API.

text.en: Each document has its own result or error, in the same order as the input.
text.ro: Har document ka apna nateeja ya error hota hai, input ki tarteeb mein.

remember.en: Check result.reason: RecognizedSpeech, NoMatch or Canceled.
remember.ro: result.reason dekhein: RecognizedSpeech, NoMatch ya Canceled.
recognize_once ek baat ke baad ruk jata hai.

remember.en: Audio in chat is base64 with its format, such as wav.
remember.ro: Chat mein audio base64 hoti hai, format ke saath, jaise wav.

remember.en: For live conversation use the Realtime API, not a chain of three calls.
remember.ro: Live guftagu ke liye teen calls ke silsile ke bajaye Realtime API.

traps.en: speak_text_async does not understand SSML tags; speak_ssml_async does.
traps.ro: speak_text_async SSML tags nahi samajhta; speak_ssml_async samajhta hai.

traps.en: NoMatch means no recognizable speech; a wrong key gives Canceled.
traps.ro: NoMatch ka matlab pehchan ke qabil awaaz nahi; ghalat key Canceled deti hai.
